No sports cars and no modern cars: the street is empty except, at most, one old boxy 1980s family sedan parked far away.

Do not include: any text, letters, words, logos or watermarks; real car brand logos; religious buildings, mosques, minarets, domes; flags; modern glass skyscrapers; people's faces in close-up.
